overview_description.description: Coalition is an active insurance company that combines comprehensive insurance and proactive cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate cyber risk. Backed by leading global insurers Allianz, Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, Arch Insurance North America, Lloyd’s of London, and Ascot Group, Coalition offers its insurance products in the US and Canada and its security products to organizations globally. Coalition’s Active Risk Platform provides automated security alerts, threat intelligence, expert guidance, and cybersecurity tools to help businesses remain resilient in the face of cyber attacks. Headquartered in San Francisco, Coalition is a distributed company with a global workforce that collaborates both digitally and in-office hubs across the globe.

about_short_description.short_description: Coalition is a cyber insurance and security company that helps businesses to manage and mitigate cyber risks.

product.name: Active Cyber Insurance
product.description: Cyber insurance covering losses from incidents such as data breaches, cyber extortion, business interruption, and financial fraud, with risk monitoring and incident-response support.

product.name: Coalition Control
product.description: A risk management platform that continuously monitors an organization’s digital footprint, identifies cyber vulnerabilities, prioritizes risks, and provides remediation guidance.

product.name: Coalition Incident Response
product.description: Incident-response services that help organizations investigate, contain, and recover from cyberattacks, with rapid claims support and access to security specialists.

product.name: Automated MDR
product.description: Managed detection and response service that automates the monitoring and investigation of security alerts to identify and respond to threats.

product.name: Active Tech E&O
product.description: Technology errors and omissions insurance covering claims arising from a company’s provision of technology services or products.

product.name: Active Executive Risks
product.description: Management liability insurance for companies and their leaders, covering risks associated with governance, regulatory changes, transactions, remote work, and cybercrime.
